step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Failure to provide entitlement information.”

Details: Type “No return call from the client or the employer. 15 - Claim Procedure disentitlement imposed for failure to provide entitlement information. Information missing. Cannot input the allocation of separation monies.”
If the claim is terminated but can be reactivated, select the appropriate BPC on the Dormant tab and select Reactivate . Go to step 6.
If the claim is active, go to step 7.
If the claim is converted to MPS, note that a D15 from the Monday of the renewal week must be included in the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction to IPOC. Go to step 8.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the AI WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + one business day.
When the WI moves to the current workload, go to step 7.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlement (M161) transaction to input the D15 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the renewal registration number.
Start date: Enter the Monday of the renewal week.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
